value.rationale: The exact response of Lovasz open-neighborhood topology to a minimal graph-edge perturbation is a structural stability question. Beyond a numerical rank decrement, the theorem preserves both parity sheets, determines all inclusion-induced integral groups and a nontrivial S_(n-1) augmentation representation, and identifies primitive four-vertex geometric carriers of every lost class. This supplies information not implied by the intact-cube Betti ranks or previous vertex-deletion formulas.
